Bill.BriefDescription: Providing excise tax relief for commercial fuel users.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excise tax relief for commercial fuel users;adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; and adding a new section tochapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales ofdiesel fuel to a commercial fuel user for nonhighway use while engagingin business. Fuel used for space or water heating for human habitationis not exempt under this section. (2) For the purposes of this section, "diesel fuel" is defined asprovided in 26 U.S.C. 4083, as amended or renumbered as of January 1,2006.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to thenonhighway use of diesel fuel while engaging in business. Fuel used p. 1 HB 2928for space or water heating for human habitation is not exempt underthis section. (2) The definitions in section 1 of this act apply to this section.
